iti74:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti74:2.1: “Monks, there are these three types of sons & daughters existing in the world.
iti74:2.3: One of heightened birth, one of similar birth, one of lowered birth.
iti74:3.1: “And how is a son or daughter of heightened birth?
iti74:3.3: There is the case where a son or daughter’s parents have not gone to the Buddha for refuge, have not gone to the Dhamma for refuge, have not gone to the Saṅgha for refuge.
iti74:3.4: They do not abstain from taking life, from stealing, from sexual misconduct, from false speech, from fermented & distilled liquors that cause heedlessness. They are unprincipled & evil by nature.
iti74:3.6: their son or daughter has gone to the Buddha for refuge, has gone to the Dhamma for refuge, has gone to the Saṅgha for refuge.
iti74:3.7: He/she abstains from taking life, from stealing, from sexual misconduct, from false speech, from fermented & distilled liquors that cause heedlessness. He/she is principled & admirable by nature.
iti74:3.8: This is called a son or daughter of heightened birth.
iti74:4.1: “And how is a son or daughter of similar birth?
iti74:4.3: There is the case where a son or daughter’s parents have gone to the Buddha for refuge, have gone to the Dhamma for refuge, have gone to the Saṅgha for refuge.
iti74:4.4: They abstain from taking life, from stealing, from sexual misconduct, from false speech, from fermented & distilled liquors that cause heedlessness. They are principled & admirable by nature.
iti74:4.6: Their son or daughter has also gone to the Buddha for refuge, has gone to the Dhamma for refuge, has gone to the Saṅgha for refuge.
iti74:4.7: He/she abstains from taking life, from stealing, from sexual misconduct, from false speech, from fermented & distilled liquors that cause heedlessness. He/she is principled & admirable by nature.
iti74:4.8: This is called a son or daughter of similar birth.
iti74:5.1: “And how is a son or daughter of lowered birth?
iti74:5.3: There is the case where a son or daughter’s parents have gone to the Buddha for refuge, have gone to the Dhamma for refuge, have gone to the Saṅgha for refuge.
iti74:5.4: They abstain from taking life, from stealing, from sexual misconduct, from false speech, from fermented & distilled liquors that cause heedlessness. They are principled & admirable by nature. However,
iti74:5.6: their son or daughter has not gone to the Buddha for refuge, has not gone to the Dhamma for refuge, has not gone to the Saṅgha for refuge.
iti74:5.7: He/she does not abstain from taking life, from stealing, from sexual misconduct, from false speech, from fermented & distilled liquors that cause heedlessness. He/she is unprincipled & evil by nature.
iti74:5.8: This is called a son or daughter of lowered birth.”
iti74:6.1: The wise hope for a child
iti74:6.3:
not for one
of lowered birth,
iti74:7.5:
shine forth in any gathering
like the moon
when freed from a cloud.
